sophie: FYI StratosMed LoRA merge (cust/stratosmed/lora-v2) triggered regressions on the int4 quick-eval pack. Posting summary + next steps. :rotating_light:
eval-bot: CI job 86742 finished — quick-eval pack 'stratosmed_quickpack' ran on commit sha abc1234, quant=int4. Pass: 82/100, BLEU down 3.8 pts vs baseline int8.
ravi: can you paste the top failure modes?
sophie: short list:
- hallucination increase on medication list prompts (precision drop from .92 -> .84)
- numeric rounding for dosages (off by +/- 1 digit more)
- tokenization mismatch on units (mg vs mg.)
maria: did we change tokenizer merges recently? I remember the adapter includes a small tokenizer patch.
lee: commit range suggestion: bisect between abc1234 (merged) and def5678 (pre-merge). if we bisect, we can rerun quickpack on each.
sophie: agreed. also note adapter was trained with extended eos token mapping:
```
# adapter token overrides in training
token_map = {"<EOS_EXTRA>": ""}
```
maria: yep that's likely causing token alignment shifts in int4 due to different bytepacking. Try re-eval with tokenizer pinned to deploy baseline.
eva-ml: proposing experiments:
- run quickpack int8 baseline on merged commit (sanity)
- run int4 with NF4 quant profile (+kv cache disabled)
- run int4 pow2 quant profile (our old one) for comparison
ravi: approximate commands?
sophie: one-liners:
RUNT: runtest --pack stratosmed_quickpack --commit abc1234 --quant int8
RUNT: runtest --pack stratosmed_quickpack --commit abc1234 --quant nf4 --kv-cache=off
RUNT: runtest --pack stratosmed_quickpack --commit abc1234 --quant int4_pow2
lee: I'll kick off the bisect first. ETA 45m. @maria can you pin tokenizer on the test container and run the nf4 vs pow2 runs after bisect identifies suspect commit?
maria: on it. I'll use container image: redwood/stratosmed-test:2026-03-21 and mount /tokenizers/pinned.
eval-bot: Kickoff: runtest job 86743 (int8 baseline) started by lee.
sophie: If nf4 restores metrics, we should change quant profile recommendation for this customer to nf4 for now and schedule adapter re-train with eos mapping fix.
ravi: also flag to support: product team (cc @sam-product) — this customer is in production on Dedicated, we need a rollback plan if the release goes out.
sophie: noted. rollback option: pin to model version cust/stratosmed/base:v1 and block rollout for dedicated pool id dp-42.
eva-ml: quick ask — do we have eval diffs stored? where?
sophie: s3://redwood-evals/stratosmed/quickpack/86742/diffs.json (small), I've copied relevant excerpts below:
{"metric":"BLEU","baseline":"31.2","merged_int4":"27.4"}
{"metric":"halluc_precision","baseline":"0.92","merged_int4":"0.84"}
lee: ok I'll post back with bisect result or a commit hash within an hour. :thumbsup: 
maria: started nf4 run now, will update when done. :eyes: 
sophie: thanks team. keeping the customer success looped in. @karen-cs FYI.
